name: yj-pocket-desktop
description: Portable local-first media search and organizer
author: YJ

scripts.test: esbuild tests/server/settings.test.ts tests/shared/async-limit.test.ts tests/voice/asr.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --out-extension:.js=.cjs --outbase=tests --outdir=dist/tests && node --test dist/tests/server/settings.test.cjs dist/tests/shared/async-limit.test.cjs dist/tests/voice/asr.test.cjs
scripts.build: esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --minify --splitting --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=dist/web --entry-names=app --chunk-names=chunks/[name] && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild src/electron-main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --external:electron --outfile=dist/electron-main.cjs
scripts.promo:studio: npm run promo:assets && remotion studio docs/media/promo/entry.tsx --public-dir=docs/media/promo/public
scripts.promo:render: npm run promo:assets && remotion render docs/media/promo/entry.tsx PocketDesktop30 docs/media/yj-pocket-desktop-30s.mp4 --public-dir=docs/media/promo/public --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --crf=20 --concurrency=4
scripts.promo:render:en: npm run promo:assets && remotion render docs/media/promo/entry.tsx PocketDesktop30En docs/media/yj-pocket-desktop-30s-en.mp4 --public-dir=docs/media/promo/public --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p --crf=20 --concurrency=4
